requirements.evidence: All four endpoints, pairing command, JWT claims, scope intersection, error codes, throttles and CORS are present (routes/api.php:7-12; app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:57-161; app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:36-79; config/cors.php:5-7; app/Console/Commands/TotemPairingCode.php:12-43). Edge case missed: TotemQueueController.php:144 uses is_numeric()+(int) cast, so priority 10.5/20.9 is truncated to an allowed value and a ticket is issued instead of 422; the queues payload hardcodes description null (TotemQueueController.php:78).

conventions.evidence: Docs/CHANGELOG kept in sync (docs/api/totem.md, docs/database-schema.md, docs/architecture.md, CHANGELOG.md), migrations reversible with down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_032052_create_totem_presets_table.php:28-32), deliberate #[Fillable] (app/Models/Totem.php:11), reuses IssueTicket (TotemQueueController.php:151). Deviations: hand-rolled request validation instead of $request->validate (TotemAuthController.php:20-26, TotemQueueController.php:142-144) and the pairing domain write kept in the controller instead of an App\Actions class (TotemAuthController.php:30-71).

security.evidence: Every authenticated call re-validates token, totem, preset and entity and recomputes the effective scope (TotemAuth.php:36-75); algorithm is pinned and signatures compared with hash_equals (TotemJwt.php:55-61); unknown/expired/consumed/inactive pairing codes all return the same 401 with no oracle (TotemAuthController.php:74); throttles on auth/ticket (routes/api.php:7,12) and CORS restricted to localhost/127.0.0.1 plus TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN (config/cors.php:5-7,41). Gap: TotemJwt::decode() (TotemJwt.php:43) does not reject an empty secret, unlike encode() at TotemJwt.php:23.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:35-346 covers the command (success/unknown), malformed/unknown/expired/consumed/inactive codes, pairing payload+claims, single-use code, rate limiting, expired/tampered/forged tokens, inactive totem/preset, ordering/scope, 403/404 resolution, priorities, sequential A001/A002 issuance with channel totem, invalid priority/inactive queue (nothing created) and CORS. Missing: float priority, audit-log-only paths, TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN, last_seen_at update.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing action (TotemQueueController.php:151) and adds no JWT dependency (small TotemJwt, 93 lines); shared TotemPriorities used by both endpoints (TotemQueueController.php:118,160). Duplication/indirection: TotemPriorities::values() (TotemPriorities.php:39-42) repeats the values hardcoded in all() (:15-31), and the catch-all OPTIONS route (routes/api.php:15) duplicates what HandleCors already does.

readability.evidence: Small focused private helpers with docblocks (TotemQueueController.php:19-56; TotemAuth.php:6-17), consistent naming and style. Minor readability drag: the transaction returns a positional 5-tuple destructured as [$totem, $presetId, $entity, $token, $ttl] (TotemAuthController.php:72-79) and resolveQueue() returns a loosely typed {queue}|{error,status} array (:38-56).

scope.evidence: The diff contains only the totem feature plus its required docs/env/phpunit wiring and CHANGELOG entry (change.diff: .env.example, phpunit.xml, docs/*, routes, app, database, tests). No unrelated refactors or new features; entity_suspended stays reserved as asked.

issues.explanation: decode() verifies the HMAC with whatever secret it receives, so an empty TOTEM_JWT_SECRET (the .env.example default) would accept tokens signed with the empty key; encode() guards this at line 23 but the middleware path does not, so the same guard should be applied before verification.
is_numeric() plus an (int) cast lets 10.5 or 20.9 through and truncates them to 10/20, issuing a ticket instead of the required 422 invalid_priority for any value that is not exactly 0, 10 or 20.
Only the 401 invalid_pairing_code path is audit-logged; malformed 400 attempts (and throttled attempts) are not audited even though the task asks to audit pairing failures.

The regenerated code is written straight into the unique login_code column without checking for a collision with another live preset code, so a rare collision throws a QueryException instead of retrying.
description is hardcoded to null for every queue (and the doc example was changed to null) rather than sourced from the queue, so the contract field is always empty.
Request validation is hand-rolled with is_string/is_int/preg_match and is_numeric instead of the project's HTTP-controller pattern of $request->validate([...]).

The pairing transaction (lock preset, consume code, create totem, sign token) is a domain write implemented in the controller rather than in an App\Actions use-case class, against the project's Actions convention.
values() re-declares [0, 10, 20] that is already encoded in all(), splitting the promised single source of truth into two lists that can drift.
The catch-all OPTIONS route is unreachable for real preflights because the CORS middleware answers them, and it returns 204 for arbitrary OPTIONS paths.
The transaction's positional 5-element result array destructured at line 79 is harder to follow than returning named keys or a small value object.
Expiry is only checked when an exp claim exists and uses '< time()', so a token without exp never expires and a token with exp == now is still accepted.
The invalid-priority test only covers 5 and an empty body, so the float-truncation hole (10.5), the audit-log failure path and TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN are untested.

review.summary: This implements the totem BFF end to end: three reversible migrations with models/factories, the pairing command, HS256 JWT auth with scope intersection, the three authenticated endpoints reusing IssueTicket, backend-owned priorities, throttling, CORS, docs and a broad Pest suite. It is close to approvable; the remaining work is hardening TotemJwt::decode against an empty secret, validating priority values exactly rather than truncating them, and a few smaller audit/robustness gaps.
